description: This file contains server-side request handlers for synchronizing notes and categories with a GitHub repository, including functions to get and update notes and categories, and to perform Git operations via SDK calls.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Handles synchronization of notes and categories with GitHub, creating blobs, trees, commits, and updating references.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes JSON content from GitHub, decodes from base64, and returns it.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches categories JSON content from GitHub, decodes from base64, and returns it.
